column1: # The structures on which the predicted solvent sites are validated, and the ligand of each: the 85 complexes
# of the Astex Diverse Set (Hartshorn et al., J. Med. Chem. 2007, 50, 726-741), a set assembled for docking on
# criteria that have nothing to do with water. The list, with the ligand of each complex, is from the
# supplementary information (S5) of Buttenschoen, Morris and Deane, "PoseBusters: AI-based docking methods fail
# to generate physically valid poses or generalise to novel sequences" (Chem. Sci. 2024, 15, 3130). Each entry
# is used as deposited in the Protein Data Bank, with its waters.
# Sorted by identifier, the odd positions (1st, 3rd, ...) are the development half, the even ones are held out.
